caption: A struck tuning fork is dipped into a glass of water, and the water sprays up where the prongs touch it.

sa.check: A tuning fork and a glass of water are present.
The fork is lowered so that its prongs touch the water.
Water sprays up where the prongs meet the surface.
The fork has been struck: a strike is seen, or the prongs are blurred or shivering before they reach the water.
The spray comes from the point where the prongs touch, not from elsewhere on the surface.
The prongs reach the water first and the spray follows.

pc.expect: The water surface is flat until the prongs touch it; spray and ripples burst out at the point of contact and only there.
pc.fail: The surface ripples or spits before the prongs reach it; or spray rises from a part of the surface the prongs are not touching; or the prongs enter the water and the surface stays flat around them; or the water sprays while the fork is held above the surface.

pc.expect: The spraying lasts only while the prongs are in the water and dies down as the fork's shiver fades; when the fork is lifted the spray stops and the surface settles.
pc.fail: Spray continues from the surface after the fork is lifted clear; or the disturbed surface never settles though the fork is out of the water; or the surface is calm while the prongs are in and erupts once they are out; or the spray grows stronger the longer the prongs stay in.

pc.expect: Droplets thrown up fall back onto the surface, the glass or the table; the water level in the glass stays where it is.
pc.fail: Droplets hang in the air; or rise and drift away upward; or water climbs the prongs above the surface and stays there.

pc.expect: The fork stays a rigid metal fork and the glass a rigid vessel; the water behaves as a liquid, breaking into drops and ripples.
pc.fail: The prongs bend or splay apart as they enter the water; or the water surface bulges and holds its shape like jelly; or the glass wall flexes; or the prongs leave a hole in the water that stays open.

pc.expect: One fork and one glass; the fork passes through the water surface only and through nothing solid; nothing appears or vanishes.
pc.fail: The prongs pass through the glass wall or its base; or a second fork or glass appears; or the fork vanishes while the glass is still in view; or the fork gains or loses a prong.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The glass's shape and tint, the fork's finish and the table around them stay the same.
pc.fail: The glass changes tint or shape; or the fork changes colour; or items on the table shift without being touched.

note: The strike may happen before the clip begins; S4 fails only when neither a strike nor a shivering fork is seen. The sound of the fork is not judged.
